text:
Alex: Heads-up — numbers on the per-model cost dashboard look inflated for small tenants since yesterday. Seen ~30% higher token costs after we started the new cache-crediting job. Anyone else?
Priya: Saw it too. Small tenant heatmap spikes at ~03:10 UTC. Could be the new crediter window or a join bug.
Morgan: My gut says credits are being applied at the cluster-aggregate phase and then again during tenant rollup — double-counting during aggregation. Check the materialized view that feeds the dashboard.
Diego: I dug in. The crediting job writes to cache_credits, and the rollup uses a CTE that ends up joining credits twice if the intermediate aggregate isn't collapsed. Looks like a LEFT JOIN + re-aggregation bug.
Diego: Example snippet I found: ```sql
WITH credits AS (...)
SELECT r.tenant_id, sum(r.tokens) AS tokens, sum(credits.amount) AS credits
FROM routes r
LEFT JOIN credits ON credits.route_hash = r.hash
-- later we join credits again when computing amortized_prefetch
GROUP BY r.tenant_id;
```
Jin: Also noticed telemetry sampling changed in the midnight deploy (1% -> 0.1%). The estimator macro scales differently when sample_rate < 1% and we end up over-estimating per-route cost because of integer rounding. Filed #4287.
Alex: OK action plan: Diego open a PR to prevent duplicate join + add unit tests; Priya add an e2e for a small tenant asserting post-credit costs <= pre-credit; Morgan schedule a safe rollout window; Jin validate sampling invariants and revert or patch estimator.
Priya: Will add an integration test in the cost-runner fixture that mocks cache_credits and verifies allocation behavior. Also will add a debug flag to surface raw credits for a tenant.
Diego: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/costs/pull/875 — this coalesces credits per-tenant before rollup and fixes the join. Adds a small unit test for the earlier repro. cc @Alex @Priya
Morgan: Suggest canary path: deploy to staging, then a small-prod canary (5% traffic / 10 tenants), monitor token burn and dashboard diffs, then full roll. Timeline: staging 30m, canary 2h, full roll if metrics stable.
Alex: Also can we add an explainability card in the console that shows 'credit provenance' for a tenant (which routes contributed cache savings) so PMs won't be surprised next time?
Priya: Yes — adding a low-cost debug column `credit_source` to the debug view and an opt-in detail panel. Performance impact should be minimal since it's only in debug mode.
Jin: After PR lands I'll revert the sampling delta on telemetry or make the estimator read sample_rate from config and use float math. Assigning owners: Jin (telemetry), Diego (crediting fix), Priya (tests + console debug).
deploy-bot: deploy/costs-service v2.18.9 rolled out to staging at 2026-02-15T03:18Z :rocket:
Alex: Thanks all — if you see residual mismatches paste dashboard snapshots and the tenant_id here. We'll track until numbers are stable. :thumbsup:
